requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6723-6887--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6723-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3967-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-6720.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2757-3129-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3375-4200-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4390-5060-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5060-5078-6757-7633.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
4390-5060-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

2292-4027-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Glint Hawk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glint Hawk enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Glint Hawk.
Repeat.
2292-4027-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

967-2097-3809-5686-7087.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

586-5147-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2544-2713-6784.description:
Activate Steelswarm Operator's second ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Steelswarm Operator.
Repeat.
2544-2713-6784.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can either use Steelswarm Operator's first ability or untap other artifacts you control.

1563-2351-4068-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-4068-6460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2351-4068-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3484-4365-5391-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least three energy counters.
3484-4365-5391-5902.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-6165.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-6165.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Serum Tank trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Serum Tank trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

1636-4178-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4178-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-4178-5996.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

283-512-1719.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
283-512-1719.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, coping Vizier of Tumbling Sands' ability, targetting the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve both Vizier of Tumbling Sands abilities, untapping Halo Fountain and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

465-1430-2719.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Sakashima to the battlefield as a copy of Mirror Image, thus making it a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sakashima.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1595-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another artifact creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-1595-3259.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Sharding Sphinx.
Resolve the Sharding Sphinx trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Thopter token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

654-765-774.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Guildless Commons.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-3180-4675.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3180-4675.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Chamber Sentry from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
